props.gloss_en: the chilazon [of the mishna's list of eye blemishes] is the same blemish as the nachash
this chilazon is a permanent blemish, to slaughter [the firstborn] on account of it
and this is the nachash that the Sages spoke of
a person does not see [rule on] blemishes for himself
but he teaches the halakha to the students, and the students rule for him
any Torah scholar who rules a halakha and comes [to apply it in his own case]: if he said it before the incident he is listened to, and if not he is not listened to
he too had been ruling [this halakha] from the outset

supports.gloss_en: תא שמע: the elder said of the chilazon 'וזהו נחש שאמרו חכמים' -- so chilazon and nachash are one blemish

objections.gloss_en: והאמר ר' אבא אמר רב הונא: a scholar who rules and comes [to apply it to himself] is listened to only if he said it before the incident! (kind svara under protest: amoraic-memra contradiction, AUTHORING_DECISIONS §12)

answered_by.gloss_en: איהו נמי מורה ובא הוה מעיקרא -- he too had been ruling so from the outset, before the incident
